name: OnNuma
shortDescription: A London-built volunteer coordination platform for churches, charities and community organisations, covering rotas, events, communications, youth workflows and oversight records.
suitableContexts: Churches coordinating volunteers through rotas, availability and self-service sign-up
Teams wanting a low-friction volunteer portal without a separate app
Churches organising events, youth activity and team communications alongside volunteer workflows

pricing.summary: Published pricing includes a free plan for up to 20 contacts and a £17/month or £170/year paid plan. The supplier lists optional SMS notifications at £8/month including 100 messages, with further blocks available. Confirm current feature limits, data volumes, multi-site rules, SMS terms and renewal arrangements before adopting it.

startingPrice.qualifier: freemium plan for up to 20 contacts

tiers.label: Freemium
tiers.detail: Supplier lists volunteer database and rotas, events, volunteer portal, youth portal, church/pastoral tools, DBS/safeguarding, children/youth and teams for up to 20 contacts.

tiers.label: Paid plan
tiers.detail: Supplier adds multi-site, email campaigns, custom forms, branding and priority support.

tiers.label: SMS notifications
tiers.detail: Supplier lists 100 messages per month with additional 100-message blocks available.

gdprInformation: The reviewed public page links to terms and privacy material but does not itself establish the current DPA, hosting location, sub-processor list, retention rules, access controls, audit log, data-export or breach-response arrangements. The supplier’s feature labels for DBS, safeguarding, pastoral and youth work do not demonstrate that a church’s policy or legal duties have been met; obtain and assess the written controls before putting sensitive records into the service.
integrations: iCal-style calendar workflow is implied by add-to-calendar links; confirm current feed formats
importExport: Confirm CSV import/export, historical rota, form, DBS, pastoral and youth-record retrieval, plus account closure and data-deletion workflow before moving sensitive or long-term records
support: Supplier provides a public product demo
Paid plan includes priority support according to published pricing
Supplier describes a free plan with no card requirement

uk-operator.value: OnNuma’s product page identifies the service as a product of The Media Lounge Ltd and publishes a London contact address.

pricing.value: The product page lists a free plan, a £17/month or £170/year paid plan and an £8/month SMS add-on.

volunteer-workflow.value: Supplier describes magic-link access, availability, rota sign-up, confirmations, calendar links, events and role preferences for volunteers.

sensitive-workflow-boundary.value: Supplier lists DBS/safeguarding, children/youth and church/pastoral tools, while the reviewed public page does not establish their detailed data-processing or compliance controls.

editorial.assessment: OnNuma is a UK volunteer-coordination platform that extends into church events, communications, youth and pastoral workflows. Its central distinction is a low-friction volunteer experience: passwordless links, simple availability and self-service rota sign-up. The breadth makes it useful for small teams, but it also makes due diligence important—especially before using the safeguarding, DBS, pastoral or youth labels for sensitive records.
bestFor: Churches trying to replace ad hoc volunteer rota spreadsheets and reminder messages
Volunteer teams that need easy self-service availability and shift confirmation
Churches combining rota, events and simple communication workflows
strengths: Free entry plan and published paid pricing
Volunteer portal designed to avoid passwords and app installation
Events, rotas, preferences and reminders in one workflow
Published multi-site, forms and communications options
limitations: A broad feature set does not replace a church’s safeguarding policy, professional judgement or statutory processes
Public material reviewed does not establish DPA, data residency, sub-processors, retention, export or access-control detail
Feature and contact limits, SMS cost, support levels and youth/DBS workflow suitability need testing against a real church
Not an accounting package, Gift Aid processor or a substitute for specialist safeguarding advice

procurementVerdict.problem: Coordinating volunteers, events and routine communication without chasing people through disconnected tools
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK product centred on friction-light volunteer self-service, with church, youth and pastoral extensions
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Run a non-sensitive pilot rota with real volunteers, availability, reminders and calendar links; then obtain the current DPA, hosting and retention details before loading DBS, pastoral, youth or safeguarding information
